thread:
marie: Heads-up — running a sweep of TP+PP configs on the meshlink clusters and seeing ~12% token/sec regression on mixed NVLink/PCIe racks. Not obvious yet whether it's kernel selection, all-reduce behavior, or KV cache thrash.
tony: Can you paste the perf probe / pprof flame? Which kernel path is the runtime picking on the slow runs?
sanjay: Also which all-reduce algorithm is in use (ring/tree/hierarchical)? Mixed fabric + ring can hit cross-island PCIe hops which blow up latency.
marie: Quick perf top (sampled stack %) from the failing run:
```
allreduce_wait            42.1%
fused_attn_fp16           25.3%
kv_prefetch               8.7%
cuda_memcpy               6.0%
kernel_launcher_overhead  4.5%
other                     13.4%
```
So a huge chunk is spending time in allreduce stalls.
marie: Runtime kernel selector log (snippet):
```
rank0: selected matmul_tile64x64 (seq=2048)
rank1: selected matmul_tile32x32 (seq=1024)
rank4: selected matmul_tile64x64 (seq=2048)
```
We get mixed kernel picks across ranks due to sequence-length variance + our batch packing.
eva: What's the KV cache hit-rate? If prefetch is thrashing, that could add noise and increase synchronization jitter.
marie: KV hit-rate steady ~94% overall, but we do see repeated evict/fill on rank set [4-7] leading to io spikes. Prefetch concurrency is set pretty high (prefetch_concurrency=16) for throughput targets.
ton y: If allreduce is the primary blocker, try: lower batch target (reduce per-batch tensor size), switch to hierarchical allreduce (NVLink-local then cross-island), and reduce kv prefetch concurrency for the test. Also enable comm/compute overlap toggle to see effect.
marie: Ran Test A: `--batch_max=48 --allreduce=hierarchical --kv_prefetch=4 --comm_overlap=on`
Result vs baseline (same model, same load generator):
- token/sec: +9%
- allreduce_wait down from 42% -> 22%
- kernel launcher overhead up slightly (+1.1%) due to more launches
- p50 latency improved, p99 similar
Logs: repeated cross-island memcpy dropped by ~60%.
sanjay: Nice. Did kernel selection change with smaller batch/seq packing?
marie: Yes — with smaller batch/packing the selector favored more consistent kernels on all ranks. New kernel map:
```
ranks 0-3: matmul_tile32x32
ranks 4-7: matmul_tile32x32
```
So uniform kernel choice reduced imbalance.
eva: That suggests two orthogonal levers: (1) topology-aware allreduce routing and (2) packing/batching choices that reduce seq variance and encourage uniform kernels. Also KV prefetch concurrency introduces scheduling noise on PCIe-bound ranks.
ton y: Proposal: add heuristic in the scheduler:
- detect mixed-fabric clusters (NVLink islands + PCIe-only hops)
- force hierarchical allreduce with local NVLink aggregation
- when mixed-fabric, cap batch_max to [48..64] by default
- reduce kv_prefetch_concurrency on ranks that show eviction churn
sanjay: Also consider kernel picker tweak: prefer larger-tile kernels only when sequence-length variance across ranks < threshold, otherwise pick the smaller tiled kernel for consistency.
marie: Agreed. Opening a GH issue with perf numbers + commands + pprof links. For immediate mitigation on Dedicated clusters with mixed fabric, we'll enable hierarchical allreduce fallback and throttle kv_prefetch concurrency.
infra-bot: Deployed canary `meshlink-ns/hierarchical-fallback-1` to 4-node cluster (2 NVLink islands + 2 PCIe-only). Monitoring: p50 latency improved ~8%, p99 unchanged. Dashboard: https://infra/ops/123
tony: :thumbsup: I'll run a node permutation sweep (script will shuffle which nodes are NVLink island members vs PCIe-only) to validate heuristic across placements. Will post results in the GH issue.
marie: Thanks — I'll attach perf traces (perf.data), pprof flame, and the runtest command used:
`runtest --suite=tp-pp --batch_max=48 --allreduce=hierarchical --kv_prefetch=4 --comm_overlap=on --out=perf.meshlink.2141.tar.gz`
marie: Action items: (1) infra: enable hierarchical fallback for mixed-fabric Dedicated clusters (PR queued), (2) runtime: add kernel-selector variance check + batch cap heuristic, (3) de-risk: throttle kv_prefetch concurrency when eviction rate > 5/min. I'll file follow-ups and link them.
tony: Thanks. If anyone has perf traces from the original failing run, drop them in the GH issue so we can compare flame graphs. I'll prepare the permutation script and run overnight.
marie: Dropping traces now. Will update GH issue with p99 traces once the canary finishes monitoring.
